rows: Who are the authors of the second letter to the Thessalonians?
What is the source of grace and peace mentioned in the letter?
God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ
What is Paul thankful for regarding the Thessalonians?
Their faith grows exceedingly and their love for one another abounds
What does Paul say is appropriate to always give thanks to God for regarding the Thessalonians?
Their good works in the community
Their spiritual growth and love for one another
What do the Thessalonians endure that Paul boasts about in the assemblies of God?
Their perseverance and faith in persecutions and afflictions
What is considered an obvious sign of God's righteous judgment?
What is the purpose of the righteous judgment of God in relation to the Thessalonians' suffering?
To make them worthy of God's Kingdom
To make them examples for others
To punish them for their sins
What will happen to those who afflict the Thessalonians?
They will be repaid with affliction
According to Paul, what will God give to those who are afflicted along with the apostles?
Relief when the Lord Jesus is revealed
Who will be punished when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven?
Those who don't know God and don't obey the gospel
What is the penalty for those who do not obey the Good News of Jesus?
Eternal destruction from the face of the Lord

Eternal destruction from the Lord's presence
When will the Lord be glorified in his saints?
When he comes in that day
Why will the Lord be admired among all those who have believed?
Because they believed the testimony about him
What does Paul pray for the Thessalonians?
That they may be counted worthy of their calling
That they may have financial success

Every desire of goodness and work of faith

Through their obedience to the law

That it will only come for some

The rebellion and the revealing of the man of sin

Someone who opposes and exalts himself against God

Where will the man of sin set himself up as God?
What does Paul remind the Thessalonians about his previous teachings?
That he never taught about the day of Christ
That he told them these things while he was with them

That he taught them about financial prosperity

What is already at work in the world, according to Paul?

With the breath of his mouth and the manifestation of his coming

The breath of his mouth and the manifestation of his coming
Whose working is the coming of the lawless one according to?
What accompanies the coming of the lawless one?
All power, signs, and lying wonders
Why does God send a powerful delusion to some?
Because they didn't receive the love of the truth
Because they had pleasure in righteousness
What is the result for those who do not believe the truth and have pleasure in unrighteousness?
They will receive a second chance
They will be rewarded with earthly riches
What were the Thessalonians chosen for from the beginning?
Salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth
How were the Thessalonians called to obtain the glory of the Lord Jesus Christ?
What should the Thessalonians stand firm in?
What specific types of traditions should the Thessalonians hold onto?
Those that are popular with the community
Those taught by Paul through word or letter
Those that have been passed down through oral tradition

God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ
What does Paul ask the Lord to do for the Thessalonians' hearts?
To comfort and establish them in every good work and word
What does Paul ask the brothers to pray for?
That the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified
That they may have financial success
That they may have earthly peace
What does Paul pray for regarding the word of the Lord?
That it may be kept secret
That it may only be taught to the elite
That it may be changed to fit the culture
That it may spread rapidly and be glorified
From whom does Paul desire to be delivered?
What does Paul say the Lord will do for the Thessalonians?
Establish and guard them from the evil one
Give them power over their enemies
What is the basis of Paul’s confidence in the Thessalonians?
That they do and will do what he commands
What does Paul pray that the Lord will direct the Thessalonians' hearts into?
God’s love and the perseverance of Christ
What does Paul command in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ?
To withdraw from every brother who walks in rebellion
What example did Paul and his companions set for the Thessalonians?
They lived a life of luxury
They worked hard and didn't burden anyone

“If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”
What does Paul ask the Thessalonians not to be weary of doing?
How should those who do not obey Paul's word be treated?
As those who should be ignored

He writes it with his own hand as a sign of authenticity
He has a scribe write it
